Your new feline body comes with all the fixings the imitators leave out. Silent paws, claws, and since this edition, the ability to land on your feet from four stories up.

Package: Minor
Humanity Loss: 24
Includes: Cybereye ×2 w/ LL/IR/UV ×2, Cyberleg ×2 w/ Fortified Ankles ×2 and Lynx Paws, Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace, Scratchers ×2

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.
